title: Installed package has no default content root
description: content.py defaults to <installation-parent>/examples/stories, but examples are not included in the wheel. A normal installed CLI therefore has an empty registry unless configured.
reproduction: Install the wheel outside this checkout and run storyblocks serve or storyblocks export.
workaround: Set STORYBLOCKS_CONTENT to an existing absolute content directory.
target: CLI requires --content and fails fast with configuration guidance (tests/test_hardening.py::test_cli_fails_fast_without_a_content_folder); storyblocks init still to do.

title: Static export replaces the previous site before the new build succeeds
description: static_site.build removes the output directory before all network vendoring and page writes complete. A transient failure can erase the last deployable build.
reproduction: Export successfully once; disconnect the network or force a vendor download failure; export to the same directory.
workaround: Export to a temporary new directory and replace the deployed directory only after success.
target: Build in a sibling temporary directory and swap in after audit passes (done).

title: Static export does not guarantee offline operation
description: Hosted maps, raster tiles, remote media, video and embed blocks may still require the network even though application libraries and fonts are vendored.
reproduction: Export a story containing an embed or an OSM-backed map and open it without network access.
workaround: Avoid network-backed blocks and author local media/GeoJSON.
target: Add --offline/--allow-remote policy plus a dependency report.
verification: tests/test_static_export.py::test_remote_dependencies_reports_network_blocks, ::test_offline_basemap_is_not_a_remote_dependency; storyblocks export --offline fails on online maps and passes once they use basemap: offline

title: Content-root environment changes are ignored after import
description: STORYBLOCKS_CONTENT is read into module constants at import time. Tests or embedding applications cannot switch content roots later in the same process.
reproduction: Import storyblocks.content; change STORYBLOCKS_CONTENT; observe CONTENT_DIR remains unchanged.
workaround: Set the variable before starting Python and use one content root per process.
target: content_dir() reads STORYBLOCKS_CONTENT on every call; registry.EXAMPLES is computed on access.

title: Optional resource accessors are coupled to oxm_web
description: Authoring resource accessors (taxonomy, exposure, hazard, vulnerability, risk) imported oxm_web.app directly, which is outside this package's declared dependencies.
target: Removed storyblocks.authoring.resources and the Story accessors / preview data lines that used it.

title: Editor empty-state instruction uses obsolete build command
description: The gallery/editor template told authors to run 'make stories', while the supported command is 'storyblocks build'.
reproduction: Open the empty gallery/editor state and read its instruction.
target: Replaced the template copy with the supported CLI command.

title: Hosted ArcGIS web maps drop unsupported layers silently
description: map webmap: imports feature, tiled, WMS and web-tiled layers only; vector-tile, CSV and inline-collection layers are skipped and authenticated content is not supported.
reproduction: Import a public ArcGIS web map containing a vector-tile or CSV layer.
workaround: Add the layer manually as geojson, raster or wms.
target: Skipped layers are listed in a visible note under the map (runtime import, so not a build-time warning); auth still unsupported.
verification: tests/test_examples.py::test_map_block_reports_skipped_webmap_layers (source check; verify visually with a public web map containing a vector-tile layer)

title: story-connections notebook cannot run in this repository
description: examples/notebooks/story-connections.ipynb imports oxm_web and uses pre-restructure paths (oxm_web/stories/data, storyblocks/notebooks).
reproduction: Open the notebook and run the first code cell without oxm_web installed.
workaround: Run it inside the OXM host application.

title: Immersive mode shows a map behind every step
description: The shared MapLibre scene stayed visible for prose and other slides that did not request a map.
reproduction: Enter immersive mode in a story with ordinary prose steps.
workaround: Exit immersive mode or use presentation mode.
target: Show and initialize the shared map only for a slide with a map view or focus.

title: Editor and asset route allow script via uploaded SVG
description: The editor accepted .svg uploads and the asset route served them as image/svg+xml, so opening one directly ran script on the app origin.
reproduction: POST an SVG with an onload handler to /story-editor/api/<id>/media then open its /story-assets URL.
target: Reject SVG uploads and serve story assets with Content-Security-Policy: sandbox.

title: Editor does not validate the Host header
description: The same-origin guard compared Origin to Host only, so a DNS-rebinding page could drive the local editor.
reproduction: Point a hostname at 127.0.0.1 and call the editor API from a page on that hostname.
workaround: Keep the editor off or bound to localhost only.
target: Reject non-loopback Host headers unless listed in STORYBLOCKS_ALLOWED_HOSTS.

title: Editor draft/publish crash or mis-handle malformed payloads
description: Non-object JSON or non-dict blocks raised AttributeError (HTTP 500); publish restored the spine through a broad except Exception.
reproduction: PUT a JSON list or {blocks:[1]} to /story-editor/api/<id>/draft.
target: Validate the payload shape and restore the spine in a finally block.

title: Markdown links and photo-scenes focus panel allowed script injection
description: javascript: link targets and quotes in link titles passed through the Markdown renderer; photo-scenes.js re-inserted DOM textContent as HTML; editor uploads silently overwrote existing files.
reproduction: Author [x](javascript:alert(1)) in a text block and click it; upload pic.png twice.
target: Allow only http(s)/mailto/tel/relative link targets, escape attributes, escape DOM text in photo-scenes, and give uploads unique names.

title: Exported navigation depends on directory-index routing
description: Story, translation and embed links ended in a directory slash, so opening index.html directly or publishing to a host without directory indexes opened a listing or failed.
reproduction: Export the site and open examples/site/index.html directly from disk then choose a story.
workaround: Serve the folder with a web server configured for index.html.
target: Rewrite every internal story and gallery link to an explicit relative index.html target.

title: Story.freeze asset names can escape the assets folder
description: Story.freeze stores an unchecked asset name and joins it directly to the assets directory, allowing ../story.md or a nested path to overwrite files outside assets/.
reproduction: Call Story.freeze with bytes and name='../story.md' then build the story.
workaround: Pass a basename without path separators.
target: Require freeze asset names to be plain filenames.

title: CDN query variants collide in static exports
description: vendor_cdn drops URL query strings from destination paths, so two resources sharing a host and path overwrite each other; prefix replacement can also rewrite a queried URL too early.
reproduction: Vendor lib.js?v=1 and lib.js?v=2 in the same export.
workaround: Use distinct CDN paths rather than query variants.
target: Add a query hash to destination filenames and rewrite longer URLs first.

title: Malformed map layers bypass authored validation errors
description: Map normalization calls layer.get without first ensuring layers is a list of mappings, producing AttributeError instead of an actionable StoryError.
reproduction: Author layers: [bad] in a map block and build it.
workaround: Use mapping entries in the layers list.
target: Validate the layers container and every entry before reading fields.

title: Ranking top accepts a boolean
description: Because bool is an int in Python, top: true passes the whole-number validation and truncates the ranking to one row.
reproduction: Author a ranking block with top: true.

title: src/blocks/catalog.py and validators.py exceed the file-size limit
description: Both files were already over the 400-row Python limit when the rule was introduced and are grandfathered from further growth. They should be split by concern (e.g. maps.py/tours.py/media.py/text.py for catalog entries, with matching validator groupings) rather than one file per block type, since many block types are a few lines and most validators are shared across several types.
reproduction: Run wc -l src/blocks/catalog.py src/blocks/validators.py and see both exceed 400 rows.
workaround: Keep adding new block types/validators without growing either file further; extract a concern into a sibling file first.
target: Split into src/blocks/catalog/{__init__,_shared,text,media,domain,maps,data}.py and src/blocks/validators/{__init__,common,maps,media,data,text}.py; BLOCKS and VALIDATORS stay thin assembling registries in each package's __init__.py.
verification: wc -l src/blocks/catalog/*.py src/blocks/validators/*.py reports <= 212 rows each; ruff check ., ruff format --check ., mypy src and pytest -q all pass (321 passed); storyblocks export --content examples/stories deck-demo --out /tmp/storyblocks-site completes without audit failures.
